payload.title: Bound living Report startup and surface initialization failure
payload.description:
A synthetic production-backed acceptance created the optimization Report Task but did not reach initial Report creation before the local process ended, leaving operators without a cover page during initialization.

Feature: Observable bounded living Report initialization

Scenario: Initial Report publication succeeds
Given an optimization run has created its durable Task
When the Report and initial artifacts are initialized
Then the first Report becomes visible within a bounded startup interval
And the Task identifies the current initialization step

Scenario: Initial publication cannot complete
Given a required GraphQL or artifact request does not complete within its bounded retry policy
When initialization exhausts that policy
Then the Task becomes failed with an actionable startup reason
And no phantom running optimization remains

Scenario: Process ends before Report creation
Given the Report Task exists and no Report has been created
When the worker is interrupted or recovered
Then recovery either resumes the same attempt safely or marks it terminal
And operators can distinguish initialization from portfolio analysis.

No client data, score mutation, schema change, or new infrastructure resource is included.
